controls.regle: Each data source and each data pipeline is inventoried and attached to a named business owner (Data Owner), responsible for arbitrating access, quality, and the asset's lifecycle.
controls.verification: Extract the register of data sources and pipelines consumed or produced by the application; verify that each entry carries a named Data Owner and a last review date, and cross-check against the connections actually configured.
controls.preuve_attendue: Register of sources/pipelines with a named Data Owner per entry and last review date + excerpt of the actual connection configuration.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = 100% of sources/pipelines inventoried with a named Data Owner and review ≤ 12 months ; partial = partial coverage or expired review ; non-compliant = no register or a source with no identified Data Owner
actions_audit: Extract the list of data sources and pipelines connected to the application; cross-check against the declared register.
Verify for each entry the presence of a named Data Owner and the last review date.
If gap: complete the register and designate a Data Owner for each uncovered source or pipeline.

controls.regle: Data assets (sources, tables, flows, datasets) follow a single, documented naming convention, whose compliance is verified by an automated check or by a tracked periodic review.
controls.verification: Verify the existence of a documented and versioned naming convention for data assets, and the actual execution of a compliance check (automated in continuous integration or via periodic review).
controls.preuve_attendue: Documented and versioned naming convention + latest compliance check report on asset names.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = convention documented and check active and tracked ; partial = convention documented but no check executed ; non-compliant = no formalized convention
actions_audit: Request the documented naming convention and its last revision date.
Review or run the latest compliance check report on existing asset names.
If gap: formalize the convention and schedule the automated check or the periodic review.

controls.regle: For each critical reference dataset (reference entity shared across domains), an authoritative source (golden source) is declared and documented; no undeclared competing source is tolerated.
controls.verification: Identify the critical reference datasets shared across domains; verify that a golden source is declared for each and look for the existence of undeclared competing sources.
controls.preuve_attendue: Register of critical reference datasets with associated golden source + result of the competing-source detection review.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = golden source declared for all critical reference datasets and no undeclared competing source ; partial = golden source declared with documented exceptions ; non-compliant = critical reference dataset with no golden source
actions_audit: List the reference entities shared across several domains or teams.
Verify the declaration of a golden source per entity and look for undeclared replications.
If gap: arbitrate and declare the golden source, plan the switchover of consumers.
standards: ISO 8000-110 — qualité syntaxique et sémantique des données maîtres

controls.regle: The quality of each critical data asset (completeness, uniqueness, format, freshness, statistical drift) is continuously measured by automated declarative rules, against explicitly documented thresholds.
controls.verification: Verify the existence of a catalog of quality rules with thresholds per critical asset, the automated execution of these rules at each cycle, and the trace of the alerts or blocks triggered upon a threshold breach, including statistical drift relative to a reference distribution.
controls.preuve_attendue: Catalog of quality rules with thresholds + history of executions and triggered alerts, including drift indicators.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = automated rules active on all critical assets, thresholds documented, drift monitored ; partial = rules defined but execution manual, partial, or drift not monitored ; non-compliant = no formalized rules
actions_audit: Extract the catalog of declared quality rules and their thresholds per critical asset.
Verify the execution history and the alerts/blocks actually triggered, including for statistical drift.
If gap: define the missing rules and thresholds and automate their execution.
standards: ISO/IEC 25012:2008 — modèle de qualité des données
ISO/IEC 25024:2015 — mesures de qualité des données

controls.regle: Data processing pipelines are structured into progressive refinement layers (raw → cleansed/conformed → consumable), documented, replayable idempotently, and governed by contracts between layers.
controls.verification: Verify the architecture diagram of the processing layers, the documented input/output contract of each layer, and the ability to replay a process from an intermediate state without side effects (idempotence).
controls.preuve_attendue: Pipeline layer diagram + documented contracts between layers + proof of idempotent replay (log or test).
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = layers documented, governed by contracts, idempotent replay proven ; partial = layers present without a formalized contract or replay not proven ; non-compliant = opaque single-step transformation, not traceable
actions_audit: Obtain the architecture diagram of the data processing layers and the associated contracts.
Replay a process on a sample from an intermediate state and verify the absence of side effects (idempotence).
If gap: document the missing layer contracts and fix the non-idempotent processes.

controls.regle: Every data exchange between a producer and its consumers (file, flow, API, shared table) is governed by a versioned data contract, verified before each publication of a structural change.
controls.verification: Identify the data exchanges between teams or systems; verify the existence of a versioned contract for each and the execution of a compatibility check before publishing a change.
controls.preuve_attendue: Register of data contracts with version history + compatibility check report for the last published change.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = versioned contract and automated verification active for all critical exchanges ; partial = contract documented without automated verification ; non-compliant = no formalized contract
actions_audit: Map the data exchanges between the producer and its consumers.
Verify the version of the contract in force and the compatibility report of the last change.
If gap: formalize the contract and hook up the compatibility check before publication.

controls.regle: The end-to-end lineage of each critical data asset (from the source to final consumption) is automatically tracked and viewable, to allow tracing any inconsistent result back to its cause.
controls.verification: Select a critical data asset and verify that its complete lineage graph (sources, transformations, consumers) is viewable and up to date.
controls.preuve_attendue: Capture of the lineage graph of a critical asset, from the source to consumption.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = end-to-end lineage viewable for all critical assets ; partial = partial lineage (missing segments) ; non-compliant = no traceable lineage
actions_audit: Choose a critical asset and request the rendering of its complete lineage graph.
Verify the freshness and completeness of the lineage (no missing segment between source and consumption).
If gap: instrument the lineage on the missing segments.
standards: ISO 8000-8 — qualité de l'information : concepts et mesure

controls.regle: Each critical data asset carries a declared retention policy (duration, archiving, purge), applied and verified, independent of the storage medium.
controls.verification: Verify the existence of a declared retention policy per critical asset and the actual execution of the scheduled purges/archiving.
controls.preuve_attendue: Register of retention policies per asset + execution report of the scheduled purges/archiving.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = policy declared and purge/archiving executed for all relevant assets ; partial = policy declared without verifiable execution ; non-compliant = no policy
actions_audit: Extract the register of declared retention policies per critical asset.
Verify the latest execution report of the scheduled purges/archiving.
If gap: declare the missing policy and schedule its automation.

controls.regle: Each critical data asset is backed up in accordance with an explicitly declared recovery point objective (RPO), and restoration is tested periodically.
controls.verification: Verify the RPO declared per critical asset, the compliance of the actual backups with that objective, and the existence of a recent restoration exercise.
controls.preuve_attendue: RPO declared per asset + report of the latest restoration exercise (duration, integrity observed).
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = RPO declared and met, restoration successfully tested ≤ 12 months ago ; partial = RPO declared without a recent test ; non-compliant = no RPO declared or last test failed and uncorrected
actions_audit: Extract the declared RPO and the actual backup frequency per critical asset.
Verify the date and the result of the latest restoration exercise.
If gap: declare the missing RPO, correct the backup frequency, and schedule a restoration test.

controls.regle: The reporting semantic model is documented and validated by a modeling authority before exposure; each measure is defined only once.
controls.verification: Request the documentation of the semantic model (entities, measures, dimensions) and the trace of validation; look for measures defined twice across reports.
controls.preuve_attendue: Model documentation + validation report + inventory of measures.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = model documented, validated, measures unique ; partial = model documented but not validated ; non-compliant = model not documented or duplicated measures
actions_audit: Collect the semantic model documentation; attach the excerpt.
Cross-check the measure definitions across exposed reports; list the duplicates.
If gap: centralize the definition of measures and have the model validated.

controls.regle: The reporting layer draws exclusively from a governed and recorded source of truth; no unrecorded parallel extraction feeds an exposed report.
controls.verification: Inventory the connections of the exposed reports; compare against the list of governed sources; look for unrecorded local extractions and copies.
controls.preuve_attendue: Inventory of the reporting layer's connections with governed/unrecorded status.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = 100% of connections to governed sources ; partial = recorded parallel extractions being phased out ; non-compliant = active unrecorded feeds
actions_audit: Extract the connections/feeds of the exposed reports; attach the inventory.
Cross-check against the register of governed sources; list the deviations.
If gap: reconnect the report to the governed source and close the parallel extraction.

controls.regle: Significant transformation logic is tested and versioned as close to the source as possible; it is not recreated in the reporting tool.
controls.verification: Examine where the transformations live (versioned pipelines vs. formulas embedded in reports); assess the share of business logic carried by the reporting layer.
controls.preuve_attendue: Inventory of transformations with location + excerpts (versioned pipeline vs. report).
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = significant logic versioned close to the source ; partial = residual logic in reporting, documented ; non-compliant = major business logic recreated in the reports
actions_audit: List the significant transformations and their location; attach the inventory.
Verify the tests and versioning of the transformations on the source side.
If gap: push the logic back down to the prepared layer and simplify the reports.

controls.regle: A shared, standardized time dimension (civil calendar, fiscal year) is referenced by every exposed semantic model — no locally recalculated calendar.
controls.verification: Verify the existence of a central time dimension and its actual referencing by the exposed models; look for diverging local calendars.
controls.preuve_attendue: Definition of the time dimension + list of the models referencing it.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = single dimension referenced everywhere ; partial = dimension exists but not generalized ; non-compliant = diverging local calendars
actions_audit: Identify the reference time dimension; attach its definition.
Verify its use in each exposed model; list the local calendars.
If gap: substitute the shared dimension for the local calendars.

controls.regle: The storage/connection mode of each exposed report is chosen and documented according to a declared need profile (freshness, volume, load on the source) — no implicit default choice.
controls.verification: Request the documented choice rule and verify, on a sample of reports, the consistency between the declared need profile and the observed mode.
controls.preuve_attendue: Choice rule + sample of reports with the observed mode and declared need.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = rule documented and applied ; partial = rule documented but not applied systematically ; non-compliant = unjustified inconsistent choices
actions_audit: Collect the access mode choice rule; attach the document.
Sample 5 reports and compare the observed mode vs. the declared need.
If gap: document the rule and realign the out-of-profile reports.

controls.regle: Each published report carries a governance status visible to the end user (certified / exploratory / deprecated), assigned and reviewed by a named authority.
controls.verification: Inventory the published reports and their displayed status; verify the existence of the certification authority and the trace of the reviews.
controls.preuve_attendue: Inventory of reports with status + certification review report.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = 100% of reports statused and reviewed ; partial = statuses present without periodic review ; non-compliant = reports published with no status
actions_audit: Extract the list of published reports and their visible status; attach the inventory.
Verify the certification authority and the latest review; attach the report.
If gap: establish the visible status and the periodic review by the authority.

controls.regle: Data residency (location) is declared by classification, applied by design, and verifiable for each category subject to a location requirement.
controls.verification: Verify the residency declaration per data classification and its correspondence with the actual location of storage and processing.
controls.preuve_attendue: Classification → declared residency table + proof of the actual location of storage.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = residency declared and verified ; partial = declared but not verified ; non-compliant = no residency declaration
actions_audit: Collect the classification → residency table; attach.
Verify the actual location of a sample of storage; attach the captures.
If gap: declare the residency per classification and correct the out-of-zone storage.
